title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1983-09-10
lineage: MAC > Nak CR7A w/ azimuth adjusted > Korg MR-1000 @ 5.8mhz > FLAC 24/96; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel, Flac 24/96; Checksum & tags created in xACT
source: billydee recording (patched out of): Beyerdynamics 180's > Sony TC-D5M > master audio cassette (FOB); Larry Sellers & the Philly Crew Direct Stream Digital (DSD)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording with a superb mix that captures a killer show, highlighted by an incredible 'Rider' performance.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape is praised as the best sounding crowd recording available, offering crystal‑clear instruments and just the right amount of ambience to convey the live vibe.  The musical performance is described as fantastic, with the 'Rider' singled out as a must‑hear moment that epitomizes why this concert is a classic.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review emphasizes both superb show quality and excellent audience recording, leading to a high combined rating but limited review count reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix with appropriate crowd ambience between songs; no reported flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with natural crowd breaks that enhance the live concert experience.
